simple.meaning: נִיר (nîyr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 25:37. The surrounding context includes Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִיר (H5216) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)
definitions.full: H5216. ner I. נֵר noun masculine Exod 25:37 lamp ; — ׳נ absolute 27:20 +, construct 1Sam 3:3 +; suffix נֵרִי Psa 18:29 , נֵירִי || 2Sam 22:29 , etc.; plural נֵרוֺת absolute Lev 24:4 +; construct Exod 39:37 ; suffix נֵרֹתֶיהָ 25:37 (twice in verse) +, נֵרֹתֵיהֶם 1Chr 28:15 ; 2Chr 4:20 ; — lamp in shrine at Shiloh 1Sam 3:3 ; especially of lamps in temple 1Kin 7:49 7 t. Chronicles, and in tabernacle Exod 25:37 (twice in verse) + 15 t. P; compare in Zechariah's vision Zech 4:2 (twice in verse) as token of merrymaking Jer 25:10 ; used in search Zeph 1:12 , compare (figurative) י ׳נֵר אָדָם נִשְׁמַת Prov 20:27 ; used in household work 31:18 ; figurative of prosperity ׳נ יִשְׂרָאֵל 2Sam 21:17 (embodied in David); also Job 18:6 ; 21:17 ; 29:3 ; Psa 18:29 = 2Sam 22:29 ; Psa 132:17 ; Prov 13:9 ; 20:20 ; 24:20 ; of God's word as a guide Psa 119:105 , compare Prov 6:23 . I. נִיר noun [masculine] lamp ; — always figurative לְדָוִיד הֱיוֺתנֿ ׳לְמַעַן 1Kin 11:26 , i.e. that his family may remain on the throne; compare 15:4 ; 2Kin 8:19 2Chr 21:7 ; happiness, delight (construct) רְשָׁעִים נִר Prov 21:4 (so Vrss Thes Buhl Now Wild, > Ew Del SS Frankenb = II. נִיר below II. ניר below).
definitions.rootNote: or נִר ; also נֵיר ; or נֵר ; or (feminine) נֵרָה ; from a primitive root (see 5214 ; 5135 ) properly, meaning to glisten ;
